ev.q: In June 2001, 474 children aged 6--59 months were randomly selected from the 73 severely affected districts
Approximately half of the children aged 6--23 months were anemic
The overall distributions of height-for-age scores were substantially lower in both samples
approximately one third of children had evidence of growth stunting in both the affected and unaffected samples
No significant differences were found in the age and sex distributions of children and in the prevalence of wasting, stunting, or underweight
Among children aged 6--23 months, the prevalence of stunting was higher in the affected districts than in the unaffected districts
A three-stage cluster sample design was used to identify districts, subdistricts, and children

methods_quotes.q: were defined as a z-score >2.0 standard deviations below the median
A three-stage cluster sample design was used to identify districts, subdistricts, and children
Data were analyzed using EpiInfo version 6.04 and SUDAAN version 7.5.
